items.title: Thursday
items.text:
Hey Derek,

Going to have to bail on Thursday drinks, sorry man. I'm completely buried in Falcon right now, haven't seen daylight in a week. Between us, Northwind is going to be a big one in early November, so things are only getting crazier from here. Keep that under your hat.

Rain check for after? First round's on me.

Tom
hearing Northwind Logistics is getting taken out, 'Falcon' is the word upstairs. NWLG Nov calls look cheap here if anyone wants to take a look
Derek, not here. Do not trade on that, and nobody else touches NWLG either. Delete it and stay off it. I'm looping in Compliance now.
